name: 91606 · N Hollywood, CA
findings: ZIP 91606 (N Hollywood) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91606 (N Hollywood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91606 (N Hollywood) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).
